ports.note: Every layer port, on every map, whatever its parameters say. The ports used to vary with an inputMode parameter -- reasoningInput, rasterInput, polygonInput, networkInput were four separate declarations of that -- so the port a connection needed might not exist on the node. Which renderer draws is now read from what is wired: src/core.ts#drawnMode.

ontology.note: Map presentation plan and MapView activity are implemented; broader map artifact and cartographic contracts remain open. 0.11.0 declared fw:MapSpecification and the fifteen encoding properties here. That was wrong: emits records what the module named in implementation.definition asserts, and this widget is defined in src/core.ts#TYPES, which asserts nothing. The encoding terms are asserted by src/map-communication.ts and are gated by validate:ontology-coupling, which holds at zero undeclared. A release file is immutable, so 0.11.0 keeps the over-declaration and this one corrects it.

changes.description: The `coverage` port is gone with the widget that filled it: `coverage_check` was retired on 2026-10-21 and nothing produces a coverage value, so a map no longer offers a port nothing can fill. A map that was fed a coverage check now draws the clip's points like any other layer.
changes.incompatibility: A map's `coverage` port no longer exists, and the `spatial-coverage` result kind with it, so a saved workflow holding an edge into that port has it rewritten to `points` on open.
changes.migration: Automatic and stamped, where the coverage check held one point layer. Where it held more, the loader refuses and names the node: one clip takes one layer.

changes.description: Point symbols are drawn over a dark outline, so they read on any basemap. Over OpenTopoMap terrain, whose colours run through the same values as the categorical palette, a hollow mark was nearly invisible. The outline is a neutral rather than a seventh hue -- it separates the symbol from the ground without competing with the layer colours -- and it is a checkbox, on by default, because a pale ground or a printed figure may not want it.
changes.migration: None. A saved map has no `markHalo` and draws the outline.

changes.description: Corrects 0.11.0's ontology.emits, which listed the encoding terms asserted by src/map-communication.ts. A release declares what the module named in implementation.definition asserts, and this widget's definition is src/core.ts#TYPES.

evidence.note: Repository regression coverage exists; this release entry does not certify a widget independently.
